units.source_text: “世间更有一种女子：平时娇艳羞涩，即使遭逢可恨可怨之事，亦隐忍在心，如同不见，外表装出冷静之态。

en.t: There is another kind of woman in the world: usually charming and shy, even when she meets with things that should make her hate and resent, she keeps it hidden in her heart as though she had not seen them, and outwardly puts on an air of calm.

units.source_text: 到了悲愤填胸、无计可施之时，便留下无限凄凉的遗言、哀伤欲绝的诗歌、令人怀念的遗物，逃往荒山僻处或天涯海角去隐遁了。

en.t: When grief and indignation fill her breast and there is nothing left to do, she leaves behind endlessly desolate last words, poems of unbearable sorrow, and keepsakes that make people miss her, then flees away to hide in remote mountains or at the far ends of the earth.

units.source_text: 我儿时听侍女们诵读小说，听到此种故事，总觉得异常悲伤，这真是可歌可泣之事，使我不禁掉下泪来。

en.t: When I was a child and heard the serving women read tales aloud, whenever I heard such a story I always felt terribly sad; it seemed truly moving and worthy of tears, and I could not help crying.

units.source_text: 但是现在回想，这种人也太过轻率，不免矫揉造作了。

en.t: But thinking back on it now, such a person is also far too rash, and inevitably seems affected and artificial.

units.source_text: 目前虽有痛苦之事，但抛撇了深恩重爱的丈夫，不体谅他的真心实意而逃隐远方，令人困惑莫解。

en.t: Even if she is suffering at the moment, to abandon a husband who deeply loves and cherishes her, and to flee far away without understanding his sincere heart, is bewildering and hard to comprehend.

units.source_text: 借此试探人心，这行径正是一失足成千古恨，也可谓无聊之极了。

en.t: To use this as a way of testing another person's heart is exactly the sort of misstep that becomes a lifelong regret, and it can only be called utterly foolish.

units.source_text: 只因听见旁人赞扬道：‘志气好高啊！’感伤之余，便毅然决然地削发为尼。

en.t: Merely because she hears others praise her, saying, 'How noble her resolve is!' she is overcome by emotion and firmly has her hair cut off to become a nun.

units.source_text: 立志出家之初，心怀澄澈，对俗世毫无留恋。

en.t: At first, when she resolves to leave the world, her heart is clear and pure, with no lingering attachment at all to ordinary life.

units.source_text: 后来相知者来访，见面时说道：‘唉，可怜啊！没想到你竟有这决心！’

en.t: Later, when acquaintances come to visit and meet her, they say, 'Ah, how pitiful! I never thought you would have such resolve!'

units.source_text: 丈夫情缘未断，闻得她出家的消息，不免流泪。

en.t: Her husband's feelings for her have not been severed, and when he hears that she has taken religious vows, he cannot help shedding tears.

units.source_text: 侍女老妈子们见此情状，便对她说：‘老爷真心怜爱您呢，出家为尼，太可惜了。’

en.t: Seeing this, the serving women and old nurses say to her, 'The master truly loves you. It is such a pity that you became a nun.'

units.source_text: 这时候她伸手摸摸削短的额发，自觉意气沮丧，怅惘无聊，不禁双眉紧锁了。

en.t: At that moment she reaches up and touches the short hair at her forehead, feels her spirits sink, grows listless and forlorn, and cannot help knitting her brows.

units.source_text: 虽然竭力隐忍，但一旦堕泪之后，每每触景生情，不能自制。

en.t: Although she tries her utmost to endure it, once she has shed tears, every scene stirs her feelings and she can no longer control herself.

units.source_text: 于是后悔之心，日渐滋长。

en.t: Thus her feeling of regret grows stronger day by day.

units.source_text: 佛见此状，定当斥为秽浊凡胎。

en.t: If the Buddha saw this state of mind, he would surely reject it as the defilement of an ordinary mortal body.

units.source_text: 这不彻底的出家，反会堕入恶道，倒不如从前委身浊世的好呢。

en.t: Such incomplete renunciation would instead lead her into evil paths; it would have been better to remain as before, giving herself to the impure world.

units.source_text: 有的前世因缘较深，尚未削发之时，即被丈夫寻获，相偕同归，幸未为尼；

en.t: Some, whose bond from a former life is deeper, are found by their husbands before their hair is cut, and return home together, fortunately never becoming nuns.

units.source_text: 然而事后回思，每感不快，此举就变成了怨恨的源泉！

en.t: Yet afterward, whenever they think back on it, they feel displeased, and the act becomes a source of resentment.

units.source_text: 不拘好坏，既已成为夫妻，无论何时，必须互相容忍谅解，这才不失为宿世因缘。

en.t: Good or bad, once two people have become husband and wife, they must always endure and understand each other; only then do they not betray the bond formed in a former life.

units.source_text: 但是一旦发生此事，今后夫妇双方，都不免互相顾忌，心中已有隔阂了。

en.t: But once such a thing has happened, from then on both husband and wife cannot help being cautious with each other, and a barrier has already formed in their hearts.
